evidence.method: cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --filter-platform for every published target; traverse dep_kinds.kind=null from the root; separate build/proc-macro-only nodes
evidence.classification: conservative Cargo closure inventory, not an exact post-LTO artifact SBOM

compileOnlyClosure.description: Build scripts and proc-macro-only packages; recorded separately and not treated as shipped runtime components.

limitations: Normal closure means link-eligible in the locked Cargo graph; exact post-LTO membership remains unproven because LTO may eliminate components.
Published .node files do not contain cargo-auditable metadata, a link map, an upstream artifact SBOM, or a reproducible-build receipt.
Android dynamically requires libc++_shared.so; that library is not present in the npm binding tarball and is outside this inventory.
